svg.title: Japan at a glance
svg.desc: A static editorial infographic about Japan: stylized map with major cities, overview text, nominal GDP bar chart 2015-2024, population composition donut chart, and travel highlights.
svg.text: JAPAN · LAND OF THE RISING SUN
A visual profile of the archipelago — its land, economy, people, and places to visit.
The four largest cities cluster along Honshu’s coasts.

text.tspan: Japan is an archipelago of more than 14,000 islands
stretching over 3,000 km along East Asia’s Pacific coast.
It pairs ancient tradition — temples, tea ceremonies,
cherry blossoms — with cutting-edge technology and
some of the world’s largest, most vibrant cities.

g.text: Mt. Fuji (3,776 m) is Japan’s highest peak — a dormant,
perfectly shaped volcano and a national icon.

text.tspan: Japan blends the world’s oldest hereditary monarchy with a hyper-modern society. Its people are among the
longest-lived on Earth, its Shinkansen bullet trains average under a minute of delay a year, and its cuisine is recognized
by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage. Yet an aging, shrinking population and a weaker yen are reshaping the
country’s economic outlook — the story told by the charts below.
